description: reputation.ru court practice integration. Fast case search, asynchronous deep analysis, and document-text retrieval across Russian arbitration, general-jurisdiction, and Supreme Court cases.

interface.shortDescription: Search and analyze Russian court practice (arbitration, general jurisdiction, Supreme Court)
interface.longDescription: Court-practice research for coding agents, powered by reputation.ru. Fast natural-language case search across arbitration (арбитраж), general-jurisdiction (СОЮ), and Supreme Court (ВС РФ); asynchronous deep-research reports synthesizing practice across all systems; and full document-text retrieval by id. Works through the reputation MCP server, with a zero-dependency REST client as a fallback.
